user.title: Create an advanced alarm clock
user.description: Step 1 of 8 · Give this independent clock a clear room or purpose name. The wizard clearly guides you through timing, conditions, notifications, and actions.

data_description.name: This name appears on entities, the Card, and notifications, for example “Bedroom alarm”.

source.title: Choose the alarm source
source.description: Step 2 of 8 · Choose where alarm times come from. The Clock Advanced weekly schedule is recommended for the simplest editing directly on the Advanced Card.

data_description.schedule_source: Clock Advanced: edit every weekday in the integration and Card. Home Assistant Schedule: use existing time blocks; Card time editing is then disabled.

helper_schedule.title: Select a Home Assistant schedule
helper_schedule.description: Step 3 of 8 · The alarm starts at the beginning of every active block of the selected native schedule entity.

data_description.schedule_entity: Select the schedule whose block start should be used as the alarm time. Later changes are made in the native Home Assistant Schedule.

schedule.title: Weekly schedule
schedule.description: Step 3 of 8 · Enable only the desired days and set their normal time. Everything can also be changed later directly on the Advanced Card.

data_description.holiday_enabled: When Holiday is active on the Card, this time replaces the normal weekday time.
data_description.holiday_time: Alternative alarm time while Holiday mode is active.
data_description.non_workday_enabled: Uses a later time on days off when a workday sensor is selected.
data_description.non_workday_time: Alternative time when the workday sensor reports off.

behavior.title: Alarm lifecycle
behavior.description: Step 5 of 8 · Choose how the alarm behaves after it starts. The defaults already work well for a normal alarm clock.

data_description.pre_alarm_minutes: Runs preparation actions this many minutes before the alarm; 0 disables pre-alarm.
data_description.repeat_interval_minutes: Runs the Repeat action again after this interval while the alarm remains active.
data_description.escalate_after_repeats: Runs Escalate once after this many repeats; 0 disables this trigger.
data_description.escalate_after_snoozes: Runs Escalate once after this many snoozes; 0 disables this trigger.
data_description.max_snoozes: How many snoozes are allowed; 0 disables Snooze completely.
data_description.timeout_minutes: Safely ends the complete alarm session after this time, including snooze periods.
data_description.terminal_state_minutes: How long Dismissed, Skipped, or Timed out remains visible.

guards.title: Conditions and blockers
guards.description: Step 4 of 8 · Optional: decide when the alarm is allowed or blocked. With nothing selected it always starts on schedule. Every added start condition must pass.

data_description.workday_sensor: When off, today's enabled weekday uses the non-workday time.
data_description.vacation_entity: When on, no alarm is armed and an active alarm is dismissed.
data_description.confirmation_sensor: For example, select the bedroom motion sensor. When it turns on while ringing or snoozed, the alarm is dismissed.
data_description.block_non_workdays: Overrides the non-workday time and blocks the alarm whenever the workday sensor is off.
data_description.start_conditions: These native HA conditions are checked before pre-alarm and start. Numeric state, state, time, zone, device, template, and AND/OR/NOT are supported.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Step 6 of 8 · Simply choose when Clock Advanced should inform you. The title, current state, and a clear reason are generated automatically. Without a recipient, messages appear in the Home Assistant notification inbox.

data_description.notifications_enabled: Master switch for every alarm notification from this clock.
data_description.notification_targets: Optionally select one or more Notify entities such as a phone. Leave empty for the Home Assistant notification inbox.
data_description.notification_events: Only selected events send a message. Blocked notifications also name the condition that did not pass.

actions.title: Action phases
actions.description: Step 7 of 8 · Optional for automations, music, and lights. Empty fields are completely fine. Start runs for the initial alarm and again after each completed snooze.

data_description.actions_prepare: For example, slowly turn on a light before the actual alarm starts.
data_description.actions_start: Start music on the first media player here. This sequence also runs again when the snooze period ends.
data_description.actions_repeat: Optionally retrigger the current output while the alarm is ringing.
data_description.actions_escalate: For example, start a second media player here. Runs once after N repeats or N snoozes.
data_description.actions_snooze: Runs immediately when Snooze is pressed; pause or stop the music here.
data_description.actions_dismiss: Runs after manual dismissal or confirmation by the motion sensor.
data_description.actions_timeout: Runs when the safety timeout has been reached.
data_description.actions_cleanup: Final shared cleanup after dismissal or timeout.

review.title: Review and create
review.description:
Step 8 of 8 · **{name}**

Alarm source: `{source}`  
Configured conditions: **{guards}**  
Notifications: **{notifications}**  
Configured action phases: **{actions}**

You can change every section later from the integration options.

error.schedule_required: Select a schedule entity for this source.
error.confirmation_required: Confirm the summary before creating this alarm clock.

init.title: Clock Advanced settings
init.description: All settings for this integration are grouped here by section. Saving reloads only this alarm clock.

source.title: General & alarm source
source.description: Change the name and choose either the built-in weekly schedule or an existing native Home Assistant schedule entity.

schedule.title: Weekly schedule
schedule.description: Enable days independently. Holiday and non-workday times override only enabled days.

behavior.title: Alarm lifecycle
behavior.description: Repeat cadence and snooze are separate. Timeout covers the complete alarm session.

guards.title: Conditions and blockers
guards.description: Every alarm start condition must pass. Example for at least two people home: Numeric state → zone.home → above 1.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Choose recipients and events. Clock Advanced automatically adds the time, state, and reason. Without recipients, messages appear in the Home Assistant notification inbox.

data_description.notifications_enabled: Turns every alarm notification from this clock on or off.
data_description.notification_targets: Notify entities such as phones; empty means the Home Assistant notification inbox.
data_description.notification_events: Select exactly which state changes should send a message.

actions.title: Action phases
actions.description: Start also runs after every snooze; Snooze runs immediately when pressed; Escalate runs once after the configured repeat or snooze threshold.

error.schedule_required: Select a schedule entity for this source.
